name: EarthLife
description: Play a life on a 1:1 real-world Earth: Earth world type (starting in Williamson, NY), LifeMap (M), jobs, residents, LifeCoins, vehicles, airports and real-time events. Includes ZMF Cinema: 12-32 screen multiplexes in every world with Jellyfin films, web cinemas (with MCEF Modern), automatic 3D and 4DX.
